profile.name: Chatterbox振荡器模拟后端
profile.description: 用于振荡器流程的非实体软件组件。它提供振荡、停止振荡以及夹板锁定/解锁等接口，主要用于测试、调试或在未连接具体硬件时模拟振荡器行为。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for shaker workflows. It provides interfaces for shaking, stopping, and plate locking/unlocking, mainly for testing, debugging, or simulating shaker behavior when no specific hardware is attached.
